phases.name: Prepare
phases.objective: Close every entry criterion before anything moves.

tasks.title: Capture the source performance baseline
tasks.description: Record latency, throughput, and error rates over a representative period.

phases.name: Validate
phases.objective: Produce the evidence a go decision will rest on.

tasks.title: Execute the validation plan
tasks.description: Run every check and record the observed value against its tolerance.

tasks.title: Execute the cutover
tasks.description: Apply the freeze, drain replication, switch the application, verify writes.
tasks.rollback_note: Return application configuration to the source and reconcile in-window writes.

cutover.freeze_start: T-2h relative to the agreed window start
cutover.replication_method: Continuous replication drained to zero lag before the switch.

go_no_go_criteria.statement: No blocking validation check has failed and none is un-run.

communication_plan: Notify application owners at freeze start.
cutover.execution_window: An agreed low-traffic window, sized from the measured rehearsal.

triggers.statement: Performance regresses beyond the agreed tolerance against baseline.
triggers.verification_method: Baseline comparison from the validation report

rollback.method: Return application configuration to the source and confirm write availability.
rollback.maximum_decision_window: Window minus the measured rollback duration.
rollback.data_reconciliation_note: Writes accepted by the target during the window must be identified and replayed or formally written off.
rollback.evidence_preservation: Capture logs, metrics, and failed test output before rolling back.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Agreed functional and integration tests pass against the target.
acceptance_criteria.verification_method: Test results attached to the validation report
